meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 在无头模式下运行图形应用，自动录制操作过程，并生成一个包含视频、操作时间线和检查结果的摘要页面，随后打开它。
howto.when: 当用户要求验证某个图形应用、录制操作视频或查看验证摘要时触发。

say.text: 请验证这个图形应用并生成摘要页面。
say.note: Claude 会运行驱动脚本并打开摘要。

say.text: 把刚才的操作过程录制成视频并显示检查结果。
say.note: 触发验证录制和摘要生成。

say.text: 用 verify 技能跑一次无头验证，录制视频。
say.note: 直接指定技能名，确保使用此技能。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude run a graphical app headlessly in a pty, record the whole process as video, and generate a summary page with video, timeline and check results, then open it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to verify a graphical app, record a verification video, or view a verification summary.

say_en.text: Please verify this graphical app and generate a summary page.
say_en.note: Claude will run the driver script and open the summary.

say_en.text: Record the recent operations as a video and show check results.
say_en.note: Triggers verification recording and summary generation.

say_en.text: Use the verify skill for a headless verification run and record it.
say_en.note: Specifies the skill by name to ensure it is used.
